Class AetherisNotebookPanel.SettingsSeat

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.swing.AetherisNotebookPanel.SettingsSeat
Enclosing class:
AetherisNotebookPanel
static final class AetherisNotebookPanel.SettingsSeat extends Object
The class SettingsSeat is one reading of version 1 of aetheris-settings.yaml. The record holds the debug-mood flag, the hover-tip flag, and the painted-border flag. Painted borders start off. Hover tips stay on when the tooltips key is absent. Other keys are kept in extras. blocked means the file text could not be read as version 1. A bad file stays unread and is not overwritten. A caller uses fresh() when the file is missing. A caller uses blocked() when the text is bad. withDebug(boolean), withTooltips(boolean), and withBorders(boolean) each copy the record with one flag changed.

  • Constructor Details

    • SettingsSeat

      private SettingsSeat(boolean blocked, boolean debug, boolean tooltips, boolean borders, String extras)
      The constructor stores the blocked flag, the three switches, and the extra lines. A null extras value is stored as an empty string.
      Parameters:
      blocked - true when the file must not be overwritten
      debug - true when debug mood is on
      tooltips - true when hover tips are on
      borders - true when painted cell frames are on
      extras - the lines the parser kept, or null

  • Method Details

    • fresh

      static AetherisNotebookPanel.SettingsSeat fresh()
      The method fresh builds a readable record. Debug mood is off. Hover tips are on. Painted borders are off. The extra lines are empty.
